reuse.why: Calls the existing getScheduledAmount only for the range case at most sites, and re-implements the 7.5% approximate tolerance inline instead of using the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions each keep their own missing ? 0 : number ? value : helper dispatch that getScheduledAmount already performs, and the tolerance formula duplicates getApproxNumberThreshold.

placement.why: The rule change sits in shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount and the API field in api-models scheduleModel, the right layers.

scope.why: Edits are limited to the amount rule, its call sites, the API field and tests.

maintainability.why: The approximate rule only reaches sites whose number branch calls the helper; three sites return the raw number for isapprox and forecast has an odd two-call ternary, so the rule is effectively decided per site.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions: numeric and missing amounts bypass getScheduledAmount; tolerance bypasses getApproxNumberThreshold.

disguised_duplication.where: Per-site missing/number/range ternaries kept around the helper call, and the tolerance rewritten as Math.round(Math.abs(amount) * 0.075) rather than shared.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains a positional 'op' and an isapprox branch; updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule and the preview keep their own number dispatch so isapprox never reaches the helper there; forecast splits the call by type.
